sql:
WITH RAGListings AS (SELECT
  CASE WHEN ps.skill = 'RAG' THEN 'RAG' ELSE 'No RAG' END AS rag_status,
  AVG(f.comp_mid_usd) AS median_pay
FROM
  fct_posting AS f
JOIN
  posting_skills AS ps ON f.posting_key = ps.posting_key
WHERE
  f.is_open = TRUE AND f.remote_us = TRUE
GROUP BY
  rag_status
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'No RAG' AS rag_status,
  AVG(f.comp_mid_usd) AS median_pay
FROM
  fct_posting AS f
WHERE
  f.is_open = TRUE AND f.remote_us = TRUE AND f.posting_key NOT IN (SELECT posting_key FROM posting_skills WHERE skill = 'RAG')
GROUP BY
  rag_status
)
SELECT
  rag_status,
  median_pay
FROM
  RAGListings;
